chapter: Ellington colleagues, singers and world tours
title: Drummers on the tour and Hank Jones
summary: They discuss Philly Joe Jones and Elvin Jones briefly joining, and Hank Jones in Hodges's group.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Was that the tour that, you know, Philly Piddleby Joe Jones played drums briefly with the band (unintelligible)? I know it was European tour where Sam Woodyard got sick and Philly Joe was brought in. one you were playing on (unintelligible) Joe Jones.
Yeah, Philly Piddleby -- for a hot minute -- Philly Piddleby Joe, or Joe Jones?
No, Philly Piddleby Joe on one of the European tours was brought in briefly.
Yeah, he stayed about two minutes and --
(Laughter and simultaneous remarks)
Yes, one of those tours, but that was up in Europe, not down in --
Yeah, I didn't know whether it was that tour or another tour, but I knew it was --
Yeah, it was another tour. Yeah. Esban, isn't that his name, Esban Jones?
Elvin Jones?
Elvin Jones.
Elvin Jones?
Elvin Jones, yes.
Wasn't it Philly Fiddley Joe?
I don't remember Philly Fiddley Joe.
A lot of drummers came through for a minute. (Unintelligible).
Yeah, Elvin came over, yeah.
On that tour --
Because he's Hank Jones' brother now. I knew Hank very well in New York.
And Hank Jones was --
Is a piano player.
Yeah, didn't he play in Johnny's group at one time?
Yes. That was our terrific piano player.
How long was -- was he here the whole
time or -- No, he was there the last portion of the band. Yes, that was when Shorty Baker and Hank and them were there together. We had a fine outfit then, very good.
